items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Sandy Williams, and we had a trumpet player, Joe Keyes, who was a great trumpet player.

ctx.x: 'I Hear Music', oh, it was just a great album, great album. And let's see, during that time I recorded with Benny Carter, and I did quite a few recordings with Fletcher during that time. I was speaking of Fletcher. I want to give you the personnel of this band. This was -- had a trombone player, Claude -- wait a minute. Sandy Williams, and we had a trumpet player, Joe Keyes, who was a great trumpet player. These guys were older than I was and they really taught me the business about band, you know, big band…
